name: Bangla Language Understanding Benchmark (BLUB)
description: BLUB is the first-ever Bangla language understanding benchmark comprising datasets for natural language inference, question answering, text classification, sequence labeling, and span prediction to evaluate Bangla NLP models.
reputation: BLUB is a foundational benchmark for Bangla NLP and is commonly cited as an early standard for evaluating Bangla language understanding models.
notes: Includes pretraining data collection and benchmarks for low-resource Bangla language understanding.
